description: MTA Daily Ridership Data: 2020 - 2025 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This deprecated dataset provides systemwide ridership and traffic estimates for subways (including the Staten Island Railway), buses, Long Island Rail Road, Metro-North Railroad, Access-A-Ride, and Bridges and Tunnels, beginning 3/1/2020, and provides a percentage comparison against a comparable pre-pandemic date. Next-day estimates for daily ridership, without the pre-pandemic comparison, are now provided at. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are commuter rail, b&t, bus, customers, daily. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2025-01-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
